transcripcion: This is a demo project so you can try every feature
Each row is one line of a timestamped transcript
Click Select on a line to start building a clip
Hold Shift and click another line to select a whole range
Press Add Clip and give it a name
Used lines are greyed out so clips never overlap
Switch to the Preview tab to see your clips on the timeline
Click a clip block or use the skip buttons to jump to it
Press Space to play or pause
Turn on CC to show the transcript as subtitles
Export your clips as JSON or as an EDL for your video editor
Save Project keeps everything in a single file
Now load your own transcript and video
